method: Three fresh-process optimized runs per variant/window count, alternating variant order. 100 edits and 10 flush samples per run. Same pilot content. Memory sampled after 500 ms idle; no forced GC. RSS is summed, not physical footprint. Paint is approximated by two animation-frame callbacks. JS acknowledgement is local replica acceptance; native acknowledgement crosses the bridge.

checks.name: newer remote publication survives delayed acknowledgement
same-field remote text survives a second pending local draft
snapshot and copy after bridge detach

memory.attribution: Direct WebContent PIDs plus WebKit processes newly observed during this isolated run; summed RSS can double-count shared pages.
